text:
incident-bot: ALERT: PagerDuty incident fired (PD:PD12345) — gpu-pool-memory-spike on region-us-west2. Trigger: CUDA alloc failures > 50 in 5m. Affected pools: gpool-8a, gpool-8b. Severity: P2. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

alice_oncall: ack — I'm oncall. seeing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` and `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` from infer-runtime. Starting triage. Anyone oncall for infra?

sam_runtime: I'm up. pulling logs from gpool-8a. Looks like one node gnode-72 has steadily increasing vmem prefetch; KV cache growing; OOMs start when seq_len > 2048.

maria_sre: marking as pagerduty acked by alice (PD12345). Setting channel to incident. ETA for initial mitigation 10m.

jamie_infra: checking node health; gnode-72 reports oom_kill logs. I can drain it and restart GPU process. If we drain, we'll need to reroute traffic — runtime, can you handle fallback routing?

alice_oncall: yes. Plan: (1) disable prefetch on gpool-8a, (2) reroute all requests with seq_len >1024 to gpool-small models, (3) drain gnode-72 and restart driver.

beth_support: heads-up: support console shows 5 customers with 502s (ticket #TKT-889, #TKT-890). They report "generation failed" errors. Will update with customer list.

sam_runtime: executing quick config change: 
```bash
./rctl pool set-param --pool gpool-8a --param prefetch=0
./rctl routing add --from gpool-8a --to gpool-small --match "seq_len>1024"
```
Applying now.

incident-bot: Action logged: config-change by sam_runtime. PD note updated.

alice_oncall: draining gnode-72 into maintenance: `sudo systemctl stop redwood-infer` then `kubectl cordon gnode-72` — jamie, please restart GPU driver after stop.

jamie_infra: driver restart in progress. `sudo nvidia-smi -pm 1 && sudo systemctl restart nvidia-driver` — watching.

sam_runtime: routing changes applied. traffic for long sequences now on gpool-small. Monitoring latency.

maria_sre: monitoring checks: error rate down 60% in 3m. Some 502s remain from queued requests.

beth_support: updated tickets with mitigation steps + workaround for customers (shorten seq_len or retry). Customers acknowledged.

jamie_infra: driver restart done. gnode-72 memory reclaimed. restarting inference service.

alice_oncall: service back up on gnode-72. Running smoke tests.

sam_runtime: smoke looks good. no `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` in last 2m. latency slightly higher on gpool-small for long seq.

maria_sre: PD incident PD12345: reassessing severity. No customer-facing outage now; suggest transition to monitoring and handoff to daytime oncall.

alice_oncall: agree. handoff to sam_runtime for follow-up. TODOs for Sam: 1) keep monitoring for 30m 2) collect heap/profile from gnode-72 3) open postmortem if recurrence within 24h.

sam_runtime: taking handoff. I'll run `nvprof`/`nsys` snapshots and collect KV cache metrics. Starting collection now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD12345 acknowledged by alice_oncall and assigned to sam_runtime.

beth_support: closing support tickets with note: mitigated by routing fallback and node restart. Customers asked to report if errors reappear.

alice_oncall: closing note: mitigated. will file post-incident doc. Casual reminder — consider lowering prefetch defaults for gpool-8* next deploy. :memo: :eyes: 

sam_runtime: captured profiles + logs. attaching to incident: https://internal/reports/PD12345/profiles

maria_sre: last check: error rate normalized to baseline. setting watch timer for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 resolved by alice_oncall at ts=6262626299. Closing channel when watch expires.

alice_oncall: thanks all — big help. We'll follow up with a short RCA tomorrow.
